title: scheme torsor pullback compatible
statement: Let i:Y₀ → Y be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], M a finite abelian group, and t and t₀ scheme M-torsors over Y and Y₀ [lem-galois-etale-torsor-sheaf-torsor]. Suppose an isomorphism e:P ×_Y Y₀ ≅ P₀ over Y₀ commutes with every M-action map. Set G=underline(M)_Y [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let R be an i⁻¹G-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and suppose the constant-sheaf comparison c:i⁻¹G ≅ underline(M)_{Y₀} [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant] identifies R with the sheaf torsor of t₀. Then there is an isomorphism E:i⁻¹_set(t.toSheafTorsor.sheaf) ≅ R.sheaf such that E(η_T(g+ᵥx))=η_G(g)+ᵥE(η_T(x)) over W×_Y Y₀ for every W in Y_et, every g∈G(W) and x∈t.toSheafTorsor(W). The units are those of the set and abelian inverse-image adjunctions.

proof.text: Apply the canonical representable inverse-image comparison and compose with Yoneda of e and the given representing torsor isomorphism, transporting coefficients through c.

Yoneda evaluation of the canonical adjunction comparison sends a section to its base change. The constant coefficient comparison takes the unit of a constant m to that constant. Equivariance of e proves the stated equation for constant coefficient sections.

A section of G is locally constant. Restrict to each clopen fibre of its map to M. The preceding constant-section equation applies on every such fibre; naturality and separatedness glue the equations.
